body: Customers scan a QR code and rate their visit in seconds. You see how every branch is doing, and what to fix first.

how.title: From a QR code to a decision, in four steps

place.title: Place a QR code
place.body: Print a code for each location and put it on tables, at the till or on the receipt.

collect.title: Collect feedback
collect.body: Customers scan and answer on their phone in seconds, in Arabic or English, with no app.

understand.title: Understand the data
understand.body: Follow satisfaction and NPS day by day, and compare your locations.

improve.title: Improve the experience
improve.body: Read comments, flag what matters and follow up every issue until it's resolved.

features.title: Everything you need to hear your customers
features.subtitle: Simple tools for your team, a fast experience for your customers.

surveys.title: Ready-made surveys in Arabic and English
surveys.body: Start from a template, edit the questions and publish in a minute. Every customer sees the survey in their language.

qr.title: A QR code for every location
qr.body: A separate code for each location, ready to print or download, so you know where every response came from.

inbox.title: Feedback inbox
inbox.body: Every response in one place: search, filter, flag what matters, add tags and track status.

analytics.title: Analytics dashboard
analytics.body: CSAT, NPS and responses per day, compared with the previous period.

locations.title: Location comparison
locations.body: See which location shines and which one needs your attention.

team.title: Your team, with clear roles
team.body: Invite your team as owner, manager, staff or viewer.

coupons.title: Rewards for customers
coupons.body: A discount after the survey gives customers a reason to come back.

ai.title: AI insights
ai.body: A weekly summary of what customers praise and what they complain about.

customer.title: Scan. Answer. Done.
customer.body: A beautiful mobile experience that takes seconds, with no app and no sign-up. Your customer speaks up, and you know right away.

pricing.title: One clear price
pricing.subtitle: Every feature for all your locations, no surprises.

includes.qr: A QR code for every location

pricing.note: Early access: start free now. We'll tell you before billing starts.

app.q: Do my customers need to download an app?
app.a: No. Customers scan the QR code with their phone camera and the survey opens in the browser.

arabic.a: Yes. Arabic comes first, and customers can switch to English with one tap.

branches.q: Can I use it for more than one location?
branches.a: Yes. Add your locations and each one gets its own QR code and its own results, which you can compare.

edit.q: Can I change the survey questions?
edit.a: Yes. Start from a template, then add, remove or reorder questions and publish changes whenever you like.

privacy.a: Yes. Each business's data is kept separate, and only your team can see responses. The survey doesn't ask customers for personal details.

setup.a: Minutes. Create your account, add your location, publish the ready-made survey and print the QR code.

finalCta.title: Start listening to your customers today
finalCta.body: Book a 30-minute call and we'll set up your first survey with you.

plans.title: Clear pricing for every kind of business
plans.body: Start free, then pay for what grows with you: locations, orders or users.
plans.founders: Founders offer: {price} a month for life, for the first 100 businesses.

problem.title: Most unhappy customers don't complain. They just leave.
problem.body: You know your sales to the riyal, but not why a customer didn't come back last week. Problems reach you late: in a bad map review, or in a branch that slipped without anyone noticing.

visit.title: A visit that missed the mark
visit.body: A long wait at the peak hour, and the order arrived cold.

silent.title: They pay and leave without a word
silent.body: At the till they say: “All good, thanks.”

gone.title: Then they don't come back
gone.body: One star on the map, a word to friends, or a visit to your competitor.

problem.review: Slow service, long wait. Won't be back.

late.title: You hear about problems late
late.body: After they've become a public review everyone reads.

blind.title: You can't tell which branch is slipping
blind.body: Every branch looks fine, until its sales drop.

guess.title: Your decisions rest on guesses
guess.body: You change the menu or the team without knowing what customers really think.

solution.title: Satis gives every customer ten seconds to speak up, and gives you the full picture.
solution.body: A QR code on the table or the receipt, a short survey on the phone, and one dashboard for every branch. You know about a problem the same day, before it becomes a public review.

when.without: You learn about problems from a map review
when.with: A low rating reaches you within the hour

who.without: You hear from the few who write reviews
who.with: You hear from many customers, in seconds

where.with: You see which branch needs you today, and why

change.with: You measure the effect of every change

angry.without: An angry customer goes to your competitor
angry.with: You reply and win them back with a coupon

benefits.title: Value you see in weeks, not years
benefits.body: Satis isn't just a survey. It's a daily way to know your customers, fix what bothers them, and earn the trust of new ones.

catch.title: Catch problems before they become public reviews
catch.body: An instant alert for every low rating, so you reach the customer while they're still nearby.

branch.title: Know which branch needs you today
branch.body: Compare branches side by side and know where to start.

winback.title: Win back unhappy customers
winback.body: Send them a discount coupon and welcome them on their next visit.

prove.title: Measure the effect of every change
prove.body: Added staff at the peak hour? Watch the wait rating climb week after week.

grow.title: Turn happy customers into new ones
grow.body: Show the Satis badge on your website and let your real rating convince new visitors.

time.title: Save hours of reading
time.body: A smart summary tells you what keeps coming up in comments, and what to fix first.

cases.title: How Satis solves real problems
cases.note: Illustrative examples of how Satis is used. Names and numbers are for illustration.

cafe.name: A café with three branches in Riyadh
cafe.problem: Evening sales at the Olaya branch were falling, and no one knew why.
cafe.found: The wait time rating dropped between 7 and 10 pm, and “long queue” kept coming up in comments.
cafe.quote: Long queue and my order was late
cafe.action: They added a barista at the peak hour and turned on pre-ordering.

clinic.name: A dental clinic in Jeddah
clinic.problem: New patients weren't booking their follow-up visit.
clinic.found: Patients rated the dentist highly, but reception and explaining costs scored lowest.
clinic.quote: I only understood the cost when paying
clinic.action: They trained the reception team and added a clear cost sheet before treatment.

retail.name: A fashion store with five branches
retail.problem: The Dammam branch sold less than the others, with the same stock.
retail.found: Dammam customers mentioned fitting rooms and missing sizes more than any other branch.
retail.action: They moved stock by each branch's demand and added two fitting rooms.

badge.title: The yellow seal tells new customers: this number is real.
badge.body: Once your business has {min} verified ratings, your score appears on your public Satis Score page, with a badge you place on your website next to the buy button.

verified.title: Only from real customers
verified.body: The survey is sent after a visit or a purchase, not to just anyone.

live.title: Updates on its own
live.body: The number changes with every new rating.

locked.title: Can't be edited
locked.body: Neither you nor we can change the number or delete a rating.
